brief:
Thirty-three years have passed since the Oslo Accords were signed as a framework for a transition period leading Palestinians toward statehood, independence, and an end to occupation, the Shehab Wire reported. The agreements have not produced the promised state but instead accumulated unresolved issues and delayed outcomes.

The accords, positioned as a gateway to Palestinian self-determination, have given way to postponed democracy and deferred statehood over more than three decades of implementation.

title: Oslo Accords mark 33 years without promised Palestinian statehood
